title: CI runs lint and typecheck, not only the test suite
desc:
tests.yml runs unittest on Linux/Windows x 3.9/3.12 and nothing else. Stdlib-only code is cheap to type-check.

ACCEPTANCE:
- CI job with ruff check and mypy (or pyright) over lib/, pinned versions, non-blocking on first land then blocking once clean
- no runtime dependency added; tools are dev-only
- README Tests section mentions the commands
